paths.vibe_code_stdio: Vibe Code CLI over the local stdio entrypoint (examples/mcp-clients/vibe-code-config.toml)
paths.vibe_code_loopback: Vibe Code CLI over the loopback Streamable HTTP listener with the local bearer credential from QDRAL_LOOPBACK_TOKEN
paths.vibe_work_custom_connector: Vibe Work custom MCP connector pointing at the owner's Qdral relay /mcp endpoint, OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration

provider_limitations: The Vibe Code CLI does not support MCP servers that require OAuth, so it has no remote relay path. Qdral does not add a static API key or bearer credential to the public relay to work around this.
external_prerequisites: a deployed public HTTPS Qdral relay host operated by the owner
a Vibe Work account whose administrator adds the custom connector, used to observe a working session
any Mistral directory submission is an owner action and is recorded only from observed Mistral evidence
promotion_rule: No software, test, or CI result promotes any provider-controlled state. They change only by recording directly observed Mistral evidence in this file through a governed change.
